You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 4420440c57892779f265108f46f83832a88ca795 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: kazuo ito <kzpn200@gmail.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2020 15:26:59 +0900
Subject: [PATCH] nfsd: Fix message level for normal termination

The warning message from nfsd terminating normally
can confuse system adminstrators or monitoring software.

Though it's not exactly fair to pin-point a commit where it
originated, the current form in the current place started
to appear in:

Fixes: e096bbc6488d ("knfsd: remove special handling for SIGHUP")
Signed-off-by: kazuo ito <kzpn200@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Chuck Lever <chuck.lever@oracle.com>
---
 fs/nfsd/nfssvc.c | 3 +--
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/fs/nfsd/nfssvc.c b/fs/nfsd/nfssvc.c
index 1575e567bbfa..00384c332f9b 100644
--- a/fs/nfsd/nfssvc.c
+++ b/fs/nfsd/nfssvc.c
@@ -529,8 +529,7 @@ static void nfsd_last_thread(struct svc_serv *serv, struct net *net)
 		return;
 
 	nfsd_shutdown_net(net);
-	printk(KERN_WARNING "nfsd: last server has exited, flushing export "
-			    "cache\n");
+	pr_info("nfsd: last server has exited, flushing export cache\n");
 	nfsd_export_flush(net);
 }
 
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug originated from the inappropriate use of the warning message level (KERN_WARNING) for normal termination of the NFS daemon (nfsd). This could lead to confusion among system administrators or monitoring software, as it implies an error or warning condition when, in fact, the termination was expected and normal. The change in the patch corrects this by using the informational message level (pr_info) instead, which is more suitable for indicating normal operational messages.
